title: Shi Khung Ki Biria (Ballad of Village Wit and Festive Merriment)
Archery Field Chants of Sohra
cultural_context: Traditional rhyming couplets chanted during ceremonial archery contests (Siat Khnam) on the rolling hills of Sohra.
lyrics_khasi:
Ko para kur para jait ha ryngkat ka ri, ngi rwai da ka mynsiem ba kmen ha kane ka sngi. Ka sur jong ka duitara bad ka tangmuri ka sawa pyngngad ha ki lum bad ki them.

Ban kamai ia ka hok bad ban kiew ha ka burom, ngi kynmaw ia ka jinghikai ki tymmen hyndai. Wat klet ia ka akor bad ka burom jong ka jaitbynriew.

Suk ma ka ri Khasi ba ker da ki lyoh, ka mariang ka kyrkhu ia ngi man la ka sngi. To ngin bat skhem ia ka hok haduh ba kut ka pyrthei.
lyrics_english:
O brethren of the clans united in this land, we sing with joyful spirits on this day. The melody of the harp and reed pipe resounds pleasantly across mountains and valleys.

To earn righteousness and rise in honor, we remember the teachings of ancient elders. Never forget the etiquette and dignity of our people.

Blessed is the Khasi land encircled by clouds, nature blesses us each new day. Let us hold steadfast to truth until the end of the world.
